concurrency: Single-threaded pure compilation; one bounded compile per call over immutable normalized resources; no shared mutable state, no worker, thread, coroutine, timer, or background work.
deployment: Offline, in-process library call inside the admitted XDL1 envelope: no process, service, container, network, device, artifact, or registry is created, started, probed, or contacted.
errors: XDL1-PLAN-BOUND-EXCEEDED (max_parameters per declared payload list, total compiled parameters, and declared core parameter list; independent negative case required for each scope)
rationale: Source allocation from docs/engineering/xdl-lite/requirements.md XDL1-SR-019 (successor, resolves XDL1-RVW-001 and XDL1-RVW-003), realized by XDL1-ARCH-04, XDL1-ARCH-10 in docs/engineering/xdl-lite/architecture.md section 4 and frozen as XDL1-DD-13 in docs/engineering/xdl-lite/detailed-design.md sections 10.2/10.3.
responsibilities: Validate every declared quantity, duration, tolerance, and bound against the closed unit vocabulary and the finite ExperimentLimits.
Reject non-finite, negative, overflow, imprecise, or ambiguous-unit values with a stable structured diagnostic.

Enforce each declared finite bound over its full frozen scope, including the total compiled-parameter scope of detailed-design.md section 10.3, and require at least one independent negative case per declared bound scope.
Invent no scientific protocol number, threshold, deadline, or tolerance; library bounds are platform limits, not thesis thresholds.
state_ownership: Owns no durable or cached state. Receives immutable NormalizedResource values and returns a fresh plain plan dict plus sorted diagnostics; persists, journals, and mutates nothing.
